race.description: Mcgowan Ac & Electrical & Geoff Peachey Mdn Plate
race.comment: TOUS (9) led and gave a great sight but was claimed close to home when resuming over 1000m at Tamworth last start. Lightly raced four-year-old mare who has come back in great shape. Just needs to handle the going to open her account. LONG LIVE (2) has been easily accounted for at his last couple of runs, both in 900m Newcastle maidens. Has handled the soft ground before and this is an easier assignment so a better run looks on the cards. The speedy NOT SO WRONG (3) returns from a 109-day spell. Will take a lot from this outing but from a good draw should press forward and be in the firing line for a long way. COMMEDIA (5) led but ran out of condition late when resuming over 1000m at Port Macquarie recently. Placed two for two on rain-affected ground so cannot be ruled out. POINTS FOR EFFORT (4)
